topic: The human eye can spot a single candle flame from 48 kilometres away
hook: On a clear night, your eye can see 48 kilometres.
script: On a clear night, your eye can see 48 kilometres. In perfect darkness, the human eye can detect a single candle flame from 48 kilometres away. That's 30 miles. You don't need a telescope. Just darkness and a clear line of sight. Your visual system is more sensitive than almost any camera ever built. Follow for facts about the incredible machine you already own.
